title: Materials and Textures for UI
description: Tech Art with UI and UMG learning content as rare, and as such, there is a gap in industry artist skills. This course will cover the starting knowledge needed to use Materials and Textures in Unreal Engine 5 with UI and UMG elements. It’ll cover everything that an experienced text artist would need to know to be able to get started using Unreal Engine’s . The course will cover in depth, importing textures, and texture properties. The course will also include a comprehensive look at Materials, what they are, how they’re used, common nodes, and why they are used in certain applications. It’ll further cover how to use texture masks and packed-channel textures within Materials.
